import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dr = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static int N, T, rStart, cStart;
    static String[] gridL = new String[20];
    static String[] gridS = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][] memo = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] cap = new int[250][250];
    static int[] par = new int[250];
    static int[][] dist = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] vis = new int[20][20];
    
    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < N && c >= 0 && c < N && 
               gridL[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && gridL[r].charAt(c) != 'Z';
    }
    
    static void bfsDist() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = 0x3f3f3f3f;
                vis[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        dist[rStart][cStart] = 0;
        vis[rStart][cStart] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.add(rStart);
        qc.add(cStart);
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c = qc.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k];
                int nc = c + dc[k];
                if (valid(nr, nc) && vis[nr][nc] == 0) {
                    dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1;
                    vis[nr][nc] = 1;
                    qr.add(nr);
                    qc.add(nc);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean dfsPath(int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2, int step) {
        if (step > T) return false;
        int[] resRef = memo[r1][c1][r2][c2];
        if (resRef[step] != -1) return resRef[step] == 1;
        if (r1 == r2 && c1 == c2) {
            resRef[step] = (dist[r1][c1] >= step) ? 1 : 0;
            return resRef[step] == 1;
        }
        if (dist[r1][c1] <= step) {
            resRef[step] = 0;
            return false;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nr = r1 + dr[k];
            int nc = c1 + dc[k];
            if (valid(nr, nc) && dfsPath(nr, nc, r2, c2, step + 1)) {
                resRef[step] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        resRef[step] = 0;
        return false;
    }
    
    static boolean bfsFlow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(par, -1);
        par[s] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v = s; v <= t; ++v) {
                if (par[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                    par[v] = u;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return par[t] != -1;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            gridS[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            gridL[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        List<int[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> labC = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> sciC = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (gridS[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    rStart = i;
                    cStart = j;
                } else if (Character.isDigit(gridS[i].charAt(j))) {
                    points.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    labC.add(gridL[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    sciC.add(gridS[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        int m = points.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < 250; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            cap[0][i + 1] = sciC.get(i);
            cap[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = labC.get(i);
        }
        
        bfsDist();
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        Arrays.fill(memo[i][j][k][l], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                if (dfsPath(points.get(i)[0], points.get(i)[1], points.get(j)[0], points.get(j)[1], 0)) {
                    cap[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxFlow = 0;
        while (bfsFlow(0, 2 * m + 1)) {
            int sink = 2 * m + 1;
            int flow = 1000000;
            while (par[sink] >= 0) {
                flow = Math.min(flow, cap[par[sink]][sink]);
                sink = par[sink];
            }
            sink = 2 * m + 1;
            while (par[sink] >= 0) {
                cap[par[sink]][sink] -= flow;
                cap[sink][par[sink]] += flow;
                sink = par[sink];
            }
            maxFlow += flow;
        }
        
        System.out.print(maxFlow);
    }
}
